props.gloss_en: Moses's prayer: [the nations will say] 'because the Lord was without the ability (yecholet) to bring this people into the land' (Num 14:16)

the Holy One to Moses: have they not already seen the miracles and mighty acts I did for them at the sea?
Moses: they can still say: He could stand against one king; against thirty-one kings He cannot stand
R' Yochanan: the Holy One went back and conceded to Moses
as it says: 'and the Lord said: I have pardoned according to your word' (Num 14:20)
the school of R' Yishmael: 'according to your word' -- the nations of the world will one day say so
happy is the student whose master concedes to him
Rav Yitzchak: 'but as I live' (Num 14:21) teaches that the Holy One said to Moses: Moses, you have given Me life with your words
